marta: Heads-up: ran node+python samples and noticed two related DX issues: python SDK default log level is WARNING (node is INFO) and X-Request-Id sometimes missing from spans.
ajohnson: any repro?
marta: run both samples with OTEL enabled and set X-Request-Id, you can see header emitted but span attr empty.
sam: found culprit: pythonredaction helper uses a greedy regex `(?i)(key|id)=\w+` which matches request-id.
olivia: also node registers OTEL inject in init(), python does it at import time. ordering + redaction causes missing id.
ajohnson: action: 1) change python redaction to whitelist auth params, 2) move python OTEL registration to init(), 3) align default log level to INFO, 4) add e2e asserting request-id in spans.
ci-bot: suggested test: start two sample apps, send request with X-Request-Id, export OTLP to in-test collector, assert span attribute http.request_id equals header. Retry once before failing to avoid startup races.
sam: i'll PR regex fix + log-level bump. olivia: you'll do the hook move and sample updates?
olivia: yep, will add note to migration docs.
marta: thanks, i'll add e2e to sample-apps CI and post PRs here when ready.
ajohnson: please backport to 1.x after merge.
